name: rail corrugation
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 钢轨表面沿线路方向呈周期性波状磨耗的现象。

complete_examples.text: In railway system dynamics, the interaction between the wheel and rail has long been hot point, for example, the rail and wheel wear (such as rail corrugation, wheel polygonal, rail flat) will deteriorates the wheel-rail relationship and give rise to strong train-track vibrations.

To clearly elucidate the wheel-rail dynamic resonance and its induced modes, a double vehicle-track coupled dynamic model of multiple flexible wheelset-rail interactions was established, and the forming mechanism of rail corrugation was revealed based on the corrugation growth rate (Ma et al., 2021).
